parameters.description: Enables/disables the CLI management protocol. It is not possible to disable CLI from within a CLI session.

parameters.description: The port which listens for CLI access via ssh.

parameters.description: Location in the filesystem where CLI scripts are stored.

parameters.name: default-interactive-mode
parameters.description: Defines whether CLI sessions have interactive-mode enabled or disabled by default. Note: changing this parameter will not affect existing CLI sessions, only newly created sessions.

parameters.name: show-alarm-columns
parameters.description:
Columns to display in the output of 'show alarm' CLI command. Possible values:
• list of columns, separated by a comma ','.
• default-columns, show the pre-defined columns.
• default-columns,<additional-details>, to show the <additional-details> column for the pre-defined columns. This configuration has a global effect, it takes effect on all CLI sessions.
parameters.values:
• list of columns, separated by a comma ','.
• default-columns
• default-columns,<add itional-details>

parameters.name: commit-tracking
parameters.description: Enables the commit-repository feature. With this feature enabled, all configuration changes done via running or candidate datastores are stored as commit-records, which can then be visualized, compared and rolled back. Disabling this policy will clear the commit-repository of all commit-records.

parameters.name: writable-running
parameters.description:
Disabling writable-running policy makes it impossible to do configure commands via running datastore, making it mandatory to use the candidate datastore. This implies:
• CLI no longer allows write commands (add/set/delete) except in Candidate mode
• NETCONF allows edit-config only via Candidate Datastore
• RESTCONF becomes read-only
• gNMI becomes read-only (telemetry is still allowed)

The value is used for adjustment of gain when the amplifier is in automatic control mode, the automatically calculated gain will include offset of this attribute. Only supported on amplifiers with 'function' = 'pa' or 'inline'

parameters.description: Type of the amplifier HW.

parameters.description: Monitored aggregate signal output power [dBm]. -99.00 means no power

parameters.description: Monitored aggregate input power.-99.00 means no power.

parameters.description:
Type of VOA control mode:
• manual - Manual target attenuation.
• constant-power - Constant Power.

parameters.description: Actual VOA attenuation at output of the amplifier. i Note: The attribute is not-applicable whenever the card is (required equipped but) not actually equipped, otherwise, a value range between 0 and 55 dB should be reported. Applicable if the amplifier function is 'ba' or if amplifier/ supporting-card is ILAx.

parameters.description: Measured optical power before output VOA [dBm]. Applicable if the amplifier function is 'ba' or if amplifier/ supporting-card is ILAx.

parameters.description: True if interstage port is supported in this amplifier.

parameters.name: interstage-loss
parameters.description: Interstage loss detected by the Power Control. In R6.0, the attribute is only relevant when node-type = ILA.

parameters.name: tilt-control-mode
parameters.description: Specify the gain tilt control mode. Defines whether amplifier tilt is automatically set by system or configured manually by the user. i Note: When amplifier function is 'add'/ 'drop' the only option is 'manual'.
parameters.values:
• manual – User manually controls amplifier tilt.
• auto – System implicitly control amplifier tilt per configured fiber parameters. • auto-planned – System implicitly controls amplifier tilt per planning tool configured parameters.

parameters.name: tilt-target
parameters.description: Target gain tilt of the amplifier. Applicable for manual control mode. Changing the attribute: a warning "This attribute may be traffic affecting" is issued.

parameters.name: tilt-adjustment
parameters.description: Used to offset the target tilt when tilt-control-mode = 'auto' / 'auto-planned'. The actual tilt may differ from the requested tilt-adjustment.

parameters.name: tilt-actual
parameters.description: Spectrum Tilt (measured by the EDFA). A 0dB reading indicates: no tilt, or amplifier not available.

parameters.name: raman-signal-gain
parameters.description:
Raman Gain of C-Band (signal).
• If there is a fiber-connection from/to Raman, the raman-signal-gain at amplifier needs to be appropriately configured autonomously.
• If there is no fiber-connection from/to Raman, the user must take the raman amplifier raman-signal-gain attribute value and configure it on the amplifier (i.e. on this attribute).

parameters.name: raman-osc-gain
parameters.description: Required when Raman backward pumping is deployed. The value is entered by the user in case the Raman card and pre-amplifier are in different NEs, otherwise it is provided by the system.

parameters.name: olos-shutdown-soak-timer
parameters.description:
On input OLOS, the system soaks for the specified time (in milliseconds), and if the fault still persists, it triggers the consequent action (shutdown). The range of this integer is from 0 to 2000 milliseconds. The attribute is visible at:
• RD20TM booster
• CAD10A amplifier whose function is 'drop'

parameters.name: control-state
parameters.description:
Indicates the current state of the power control adjustment for the preamplifier:
• unknown : default value, awaiting update.
• not-applicable : if in manual control-mode. • stopped : control loop suspended due to a fault disable condition.
• converged : three consecutive control cycles with no adjustments.
• fine-tuning : less than 0.5dB from target.
• adjusting : greater than 0.5d
parameters.values:
• unknown
• not-applicable
• stopped
• converged
• fine-tuning
• adjusting

parameters.name: olos-shutdown-disable
parameters.description:
If it is set to be true, on input OLOS, EDFA shutdown does not depend on absence of input light. It is visible at:
• pre-amplifier of RD20TM;
• CAD10A amplifier whose function is 'add'. When configured to true, the EDFA is not shut down if it has no input light. In this case, the non-service affecting alarm OLOS- SHUTDOWN-DISABLED is raised.

parameters.name: control-speed-factor
parameters.description: Control speed factor for the DGE power control algorithm. The value is conveyed to system power control on the EDFA object.
